message.content:
Let `A = ∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx`.

Using integration by parts:

`A = exp(x)*cos(x) + ∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx`

Let `B = ∫ exp(x)*sin(x) dx`:

`B = exp(x)*sin(x) - ∫ exp(x)*cos(x) dx = exp(x)*sin(x) - A`

So:

`A = exp(x)*cos(x) + exp(x)*sin(x) - A`

`2*A = exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x))`

`A = exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x))*(1/2)`

Therefore:

`∫ -3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx = -3*A = -3*exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x))*(1/2) + C`

<answer>-3*exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x))*(1/2) + C</answer>
